content.text: – TSH-r antibodies cause ↑ TH synth, release, & thyroid gland growth worse w/ stress (preg, illness)
: potentially fatal comp of untx thyrotoxicosis USU
▪︎MC precipitant: infect/sepsis - others trauma · acute event
ddx Chagas dz: Trypanosoma cruzi (reduviid bug · blood transfusion) - chronic → cardiomyopathy · dysrhythmias · megaesophagus · megacolon - tx benznidazole · nifurtimox
ddx cor pulmonale: R HF from pulm source (ex COPD) - vs high-output HF of hyperthyroidism
•rapid speech · emotional lability · lid retraction · prox weakness
: nonpitting · edematous · pink-brown plaques/nodules on skin
-HTN · tachy out of prop to fever
-high-output HF (DOE · JVD · pulm edema) → CHF → cardiogenic shock
•Preg: 1st tri → PTU (MMI teratogenic: aplasia cutis, choanal/esophageal atresia)
•2nd/3rd tri → switch to MMI (PTU hepatotoxicity — BBW)
•MMI faster · fewer SE (teratogenic) - PTU ⍉1st line in kids
⚠️ Blueprint "PTU = DOC in pregnancy" = 1st trimester only
•BB 1st (atenolol · metoprolol · propranolol) - relieves palpitations · tachy · tremor · anxiety · heat intol - prevents dysrhythmia
•then methimazole - admit or d/c w close f/u
- RAI or surg only after ≥1mo med tx
- iodine only after thionamide (else fuels new hormone synth in TA/TMG) - reserve for admitted pts
•thionamide (PTU/methimazole) inhibits TPO → iodine 1h later blocks release - never iodine b4 thionamide
thyroid cell destruction by anti-TPO & anti-thyroglobulin antibodies
MC seen in elderly women in winter
ddx pulm HTN: comp of COPD or recurr PE - unlikely in hypothyroidism
: fatigue · sluggishness · memory loss · depression · ↓ DTR
•↓contractility · resp musc fatigue · ↓resp response to hypercapnia/hypoxemia → ↓exercise tol · DOE
-glycosaminoglycan accum → face & LE edema - nonpitting (vs pitting in CHF)
- often returns to euthyroid when D/C
